risk_surfaces.reason: Domain transition preserves occurredOn and plannedOn while recording effectiveOn on pending-to-effective transition.
Statement test proves August/effectiveOn wins over July/plannedOn and June/occurredOn.
Integration test fixture proves January/occurredOn is the realized report period despite February plannedOn and March effectiveOn.
Update no longer derives occurredOn from effectiveOn/plannedOn; transition test asserts original economic date remains unchanged.
Existing deterministic reconciliation updates status/audit metadata without rewriting occurredOn/plannedOn/effectiveOn.
The same three-date pattern is intentionally asserted differently by Statement and realized-report tests.
posted/reconciled with explicit effectiveOn:null raises TRANSACTION_EFFECTIVE_DATE_REQUIRED; planned/suggested clear effectiveOn.
Canonical doc defines all three fields, producer matrix, per-use precedence, legacy fallback and date-only determinism; status index points to it.
Pending-to-effective default derives YYYY-MM-DD from the ISO UTC transition instant and docs forbid browser timezone reinterpretation.
